thread:
incident-bot: Pager: high 5xx rate observed on runtime-prod (east-1). Alert: log_alerts/5xx-surge. Triggered at 1865012345
carol: i'm oncall — investigating now
alice: looking at the stream — big burst of 502s all from model-worker-12 cluster, started ~1865012300
ben: i see a pattern: internal retry loop generating repeated 502 logs that are noisy. this rule was matching too broadly
ben: current rule (simplified):
```
index=prod_logs service=runtime "response_status=5.." | count by service, pod
```
ben: proposed quick filter to suppress internal retry noise while we mitigate:
```
index=prod_logs service=runtime "response_status=5.." | where not match(message, "(?i)retry loop.*status=502.*client=internal-service") | count by service, pod
```
carol: can we put a 30m suppression on the pager for that signature? i can ack if the noise falls
dave: created suppression rule: scope=runtime-prod, filter=(client=="internal-service" AND status==502), duration=30m. applied at 1865012380
incident-bot: Suppression applied by dave — alerts matching suppression will be silenced for 30m
carol: noise dropped by ~85% after suppression. customer-facing endpoints (edge-frontend) show normal latency and error rates. marking mitigated for now
eva: making a quick dashboard widget to track 5xx by upstream client and pod: https://dashboards.redwood/prod/5xx-by-upstream (temp link)
alice: opening follow-up: INF-5421 to: 1) add signature to permanent alert rule, 2) add dashboard, 3) update runbook and regression eval
ben: recommended permanent signature regex (case-insensitive): `retry loop.*status=502.*client=internal-service` — we'll add as an exclusion OR as a separate low-priority signature
ben: also suggesting threshold change: bump alert to 10/min per service aggregated to reduce noisy small bursts
carol: handing off post-incident tuning to ben and dashboard/runbook work to alice. i'm going off-call in 45m — ping me if anything spills back up
dave: customer impact note: 12 customers saw >1 retry-triggered 502, 3 customers had a single user-visible error. no major data loss. recorded in INF-5421
eva: assigning post-incident docs: alice to own postmortem, ben to own alert rule change, dave to verify suppression removal automation
alice: will test the updated query in staging then rollout canary to prod. ETA ~2h
ben: will craft the new signature and threshold PR, link it here when ready: https://git.redwood/infrastructure/alert-rules/pulls/123
carol: thanks team — good quick mitigation. follow-up: include a small eval set to detect regressions when we add the exclusion
(reacts: :thumbsup: alice, :eyes: dave, :tada: eva)
